children.doc: /** 🔎️ Statechart inspection: the inspection events, the `Inspector` port, the null inspector and the microstep trace recorder. TypeScript twin of `🔎️inspect/🦀️.rs`. */

/** 🧠️ Statechart kernel: the SCXML-style microstep and macrostep algorithm over the compiled tables (domains, entry and exit sets, conflict resolution, run to completion). TypeScript twin of `🧠️kernel/🦀️.rs`. */
/** 🌐️ Statechart hosts: the `Host` port a machine runs on, the native host and the deterministic test host. TypeScript twin of `🌐️host/🦀️.rs`. */
/** 💾️ Statechart persistence: persisted snapshots, migrations, `persist` and `restore`. TypeScript twin of `💾️persist/🦀️.rs`. */
/** 🎬️ Statechart runtime: actors, the actor system and command routing. TypeScript twin of `🎬️runtime/🦀️.rs`. */
/** 🔁️ Statechart stepping: the step inspector and the `MachineStep` driver with `start` and `step`. TypeScript twin of `🔁️step/🦀️.rs`. */
/** 🧭️ Statechart testing: the explorer, invariants, conformance runner and the in-source suite of the machine package. TypeScript twin of `🧭️testing/🦀️.rs`. */
